author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A 2 mm vitrinellid snail that lives on sponges and in crevices; recorded at Portete and between Cahuita and Gandoca.
note.es: Un caracol vitrinélido de 2 mm que vive sobre esponjas y en grietas; registrado en Portete y entre Cahuita y Gandoca.

evidence: GBIF: 3 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)
Rodríguez Sevilla et al. 2003: Portete; Cahuita to Gandoca

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399
GBIF occurrence records (INBio and museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
